agent_report.summary: Implemented the Unfinished panel (Issue #23): added pure `unfinishedBefore`/`moveItem` functions in state.js, a new derived-only "Unfinished" section in the UI (below Priorities/Tasks/Commitments, above the week panel) with per-row Complete/Move-to-this-day actions and a live count/empty-state summary, plus CSS that stacks rows vertically to avoid the #21 text-squeeze defect. Added 13 new Playwright tests covering all 11 acceptance criteria and 2 new screenshots; full suite (69 tests) passes. Documented every design decision in DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #24 (branch ant/issue-23) closing #23.
